mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, file_name, storage_path, storage_provider, bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, file_size, visibility, parse_status, created_at FROM knowledge_file WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
